text: UBI funded by money printing is just inflation by another name. Hard pass.

text: The Stockton trial showed UBI recipients found MORE work, not less. The 'people will stop working' fear is wrong.

text: Why give the same check to a billionaire and a single mom? Targeted aid is more efficient than UBI.

text: I want to see ten more years of pilots before any country commits to UBI nationally.

text: UBI would mean musicians, writers and caretakers could afford to keep doing the work society quietly depends on.
